editOpportunityReferenceTitle: Edit suggestion card title: add citations to the article.
editOpportunityLinksTitle: Edit suggestion card title: add internal wikilinks.
editOpportunityHeadingsTitle: Edit suggestion card title: improve section headings.
editOpportunityImagesTitle: Edit suggestion card title: add images or other media.
editOpportunityInfoboxTitle: Edit suggestion card title: add an infobox.
editOpportunityCategoriesTitle: Edit suggestion card title: add categories.
editOpportunityExpandTitle: Edit suggestion card title: expand a short article.
relatedTo: Card supporting line. $1 = title of the saved article or name of the list the recommendation comes from.
errorFeaturedRateLimited: Error when the featured-content feed returns HTTP 429.
errorFeaturedHttp: Error when the featured-content feed fails. $1 = HTTP status code.
errorFeaturedOffline: Error when the featured-content feed request fails without a response.
errorTrendingRateLimited: Error when the trending (most-read) feed returns HTTP 429. "Trending articles" is the module name, hence the singular verb in English.
errorTrendingHttp: Error when the trending feed fails. $1 = HTTP status code.
errorTrendingOffline: Error when the trending feed request fails without a response.
errorDiscussions: Error for one noticeboard. $1 = noticeboard page title.
anonymous: Editor name shown when a revision has no username.
reverted: Status label on an edit that was reverted (refers to "modification", feminine in French).
noEditSummary: Shown when an edit has no summary.
editSummaryQuote: Quoted edit summary. $1 = the editor’s summary text. Use your language’s quotation marks.
editSummaryLabeledQuote: Edit summary with a label. $1 = section link (e.g. "→Members") or revert prefix, $2 = the editor’s text.
newListName: Default name of a reading list created from the save toast.
viewsLastDays: $1 = compact view count, $2 = number of days (7).
wordCount: Article length. $1 = formatted word count, $2 = the raw number (use it for PLURAL).
